seg.seg_rev_note: Two segments: Freight Group and Transit Group. Segment sales = sales to external customers as published. Note: Wabtec later reclassified some businesses between segments (e.g., Q1-14 10-Q shows Q1-13 Freight $313.7m / Transit $301.8m vs. originally reported $305.9m / $309.6m); figures here are as originally reported.
seg.notes: Segment sales from 10-Q segment note (external sales). Segment income from operations (and Corporate Activities & Elimination) from the 10-Q segment note; the release does not publish segment operating income. legacy_pl = three-month 'Sales by product' table from the 10-Q segment note (as originally reported). Bridge from the 10-Q MD&A sales-change table (acquisitions / change by product line / foreign exchange). 'organic' COMPUTED as sum of the product-line change rows (Specialty Products & Electronics, Brake Products, Remanufacturing, Overhaul & Build, Other Transit Products, Other); not labeled organic by the company. Backlog: release states total multi-year backlog 'increased to a record $2.18 billion'; no 12-month split.

ngaap.guidance: Increased 2014 guidance for EPS to $3.58-$3.62, with revenues expected to be up about 18 percent for the year.
ngaap.notes: No adjusted results published. Release states sales +26% with 'about half of the growth due to acquisitions'; Q3 CFO $93m; repurchased 124,600 shares for $10m.
